Resolves #19749

The bigData example's Settings tab gets a "Column menus" checkbox, so the 13.3 header menus finally have a page that turns them on. The checkbox sets `grid.columnMenu`. In `onConstructed()` it takes its state from the grid rather than from a default of its own (Vega's ask on the fork). It also follows a change made on the grid directly: the example's `GridContainer` fires `columnMenuChange` from `afterSetColumnMenu`, and the controls listen. The engine is untouched.

Related: #19643, #19712

Evidence: L3 (real Chromium, real App Worker and a private Neural Link bridge; clicks through the visible label) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-2).

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `BigDataNL.spec.mjs` › "the Column menus checkbox switches the header menus and follows the grid". Ticking sets `grid.columnMenu`, every header button follows and the menu triggers appear; unticking clears them all |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: the same test asserts the unchecked start against `grid.columnMenu === false`, then flips the grid through `setProperties` and expects the box checked |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: the default stays off (asserted at the start of the same test). `HeaderMenuInteractionNL.spec.mjs` still passes, though it switches bigData's grid on directly |
